metadata.target_venue_type: Q1 Agricultural Informatics / Remote Sensing Journal (e.g., COMPAG, Remote Sensing, ISPRS); PRISMA-ScR Scoping Review
metadata.title: Reliability and Generalization in UAV Crop-Weed Mapping: A Scoping Review

epistemology.unit_of_analysis: Linked study/report families (collapsing preprints, conference proceedings, and dataset repositories into their primary journal report), with separate evaluation-setting rows for each materially distinct dataset/split/shift/target-data-use condition; repeated seeds are grouped within a setting.
epistemology.trustworthiness_framework: Transparent scoping evidence map with PRISMA-ScR reporting; protocol-specific provenance, single-reviewer agent-assisted triage with multi-rater verification sampling (Fleiss/Cohen kappa), and evaluation-design charting.
epistemology.epistemological_rationale: Descriptive evidence mapping combines structured categorical counts with qualitative comparison of evaluation designs; it does not estimate pooled causal effects or assume generalization from reported in-distribution accuracy.

research_questions.text: How do UAV crop-weed mapping studies define and evaluate reliability under spectral degradation, sensor differences, and temporal shift?
research_questions.synthesis_type: Descriptive evidence map and narrative comparison

inclusion.criterion: Uses UAV-acquired imagery for crop/weed detection, segmentation, classification, or spatial weed mapping in an agricultural context (arable row crops, broadacre cereals, vegetables, or managed perennial orchards, vineyards, and pastures); UAV results must be separable in mixed-platform studies.

Primary empirical method study or dataset/benchmark report describing a UAV crop/weed mapping method, experiment, or annotated dataset. Journal, conference, and substantive preprint reports are eligible (linked into study families). In-window method studies (2020-2026) evaluated on pre-2020 UAV datasets (e.g., WeedMap 2018) are eligible. Missing evaluation details are charted as not reported; records with missing abstracts matching UAV+weed title heuristics and inaccessible full texts remain pending retrieval/audit rather than auto-excluded.

Published from 2020 through the recorded final search cutoff, inclusive; English full text in scope. Older foundational UAV datasets remain background/provenance sources unless a logged amendment expands eligibility. Screened under Option C (single lead reviewer Mouadh Bekhouche confirming all agent triage suggestions, with independent ~10% random sample plus boundary-exclude verification by Soumia Zertal and Fadhila Djenba).

exclusion.criterion: Satellite-only, ground-robot-only (including studies framed around field weed mapping that evaluate exclusively on proximal/ground datasets such as Sugar Beets 2016, CWFID, or DeepWeeds without UAV data), handheld, or laboratory/pot imaging with no separable eligible UAV mapping evidence.

UAV navigation/SLAM, yield estimation only, crop disease/pest damage, wildlife crop damage, crop lodging, phenotyping, or non-agricultural vegetation mapping (e.g., invasive aquatic weeds such as water hyacinth, forestry/wildfire, urban turfgrass) without a separable agricultural crop/weed localization, classification, or mapping task.

Confirmed review (systematic, scoping, narrative, or bibliometric), editorial, commentary, protocol-only report, or standalone abstract with no associated substantive primary report. An incomplete search-provider abstract (abstract=null) or failure to retrieve full text is not this exclusion; retain useful reviews as background for citation chasing.
Outside the frozen publication date (published before 2020 or after the recorded final search cutoff date) or non-English full text after bibliographic/full-text verification.

matrix_dimensions.name: Study Reports
matrix_dimensions.description: Study identity (STU-*), all linked report versions (journal, conference, preprint, Zenodo/dataset DOI), publication status and dates. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Task Context
matrix_dimensions.description: Crop species, weed classes (species-level vs broadleaf/narrowleaf/generic), agricultural setting (arable row, broadacre cereal, vegetable, perennial orchard/pasture), and vision task (semantic_segmentation | instance_segmentation | object_detection | patch_classification | ordinal_density_regression); separate non-UAV components. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Dataset Units
matrix_dimensions.description: Dataset name/re-use status (novel_primary vs reused_benchmark such as WeedMap/WeedsGalore/CoFly-WeedDB), unique fields/orthomosaics/flights/dates/seasons, tile dimensions, and true independent biological/spatial units versus raw tile/image count. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Sensor Inputs
matrix_dimensions.description: Sensor/platform, physical bands (RGB | MS_narrowband | Hyperspectral | Thermal | LiDAR_DSM), ground sampling distance (GSD mm/px), flight altitude, radiometric calibration state (uncalibrated_DN | sunshine_sensor_only | calibrated_reflectance_panel | not_reported), and derived indices actually used. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Availability Alignment
matrix_dimensions.description: Tested stress and degradation conditions (none_assumed_ideal | natural_motion_blur | band_coregistration_shift | illumination_radiometric_drift | altitude_GSD_shift | missing_modality_dropout); explicitly distinguish synthetic perturbation from naturally observed field stress. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Temporal Design
matrix_dimensions.description: Temporal sampling structure (single_date_snapshot | multi_date_pooled_random | multi_growth_stage_BBCH | heldout_date_same_season | heldout_cross_year); distinguish multiple acquisition dates pooled in training from genuine held-out temporal generalization testing. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Split Protocol
matrix_dimensions.description: Train/validation/test partitioning unit (random_tile_same_orthomosaic | spatial_block_same_field | acquisition_flight_holdout | cross_field_same_farm | cross_location_independent | cross_year | not_reported), spatial autocorrelation/overlap leakage risk, and target-domain data exposure during development. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Fusion Mechanism
matrix_dimensions.description: Multimodal/spectral integration mechanism (single_stream_rgb | early_band_stacking | late_decision_fusion | cross_modal_attention_gating | decoupled_radiance_index_streams) and presence of matched single-modality ablation controls; separate mechanism claims from tested interventions. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Uncertainty Calibration
matrix_dimensions.description: Uncertainty and calibration regime (none | uncalibrated_confidence_threshold | probabilistic_predictive_uncertainty | post_hoc_calibration_ECE_Brier | risk_aware_abstention_or_validity_gate); learned attention weights and hardware precision quantization (FP16/INT8) are not statistical probability calibration. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Metrics Comparators
matrix_dimensions.description: Weed-class-specific metrics (weed IoU, weed F1, mAP@50, mAP@50-95, R2 weed cover) versus background-inflated overall accuracy (OA/mIoU), matched baseline comparators, repeated random seeds, and variance reporting; no cross-dataset metric ranking. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Transfer Outcomes
matrix_dimensions.description: Transfer evaluation regime (in_distribution_only | zero_shot_direct_transfer | few_shot_fine_tuning | unsupervised_domain_adaptation | test_time_adaptation | self_labeled_crop_row_pseudo_gt) and quantitative performance drop (delta IoU/F1) across fields, dates, sensors, or crops; explicitly preserve failed transfer outcomes. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Provenance Limits
matrix_dimensions.description: Verbatim quote and section/page/table locator per substantive charted value; strictly distinguish not_reported, unavailable, conflicting, and not_applicable evidence states. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.

matrix_dimensions.name: Open Science
matrix_dimensions.description: Dataset availability (public_direct_url | upon_request | not_available), code/weights availability, license, retractions/corrections, and funding/COI disclosures; charted descriptively rather than used as exclusion cutoffs. Preliminary narrative only; accepted charting requires CHARTING_CODEBOOK.md and charting.schema.json. Do not collapse evidence states or mix evaluation settings.
